denominator: All target bullets in the verified training targets; not training rows, prompts, model outputs from another run, or lexical occurrences.
execution: Once only after this lexicon freeze is committed and Integrator delivers verified target text plus provenance. Input schema and bullet extraction must be bound before invocation; no rates are computed during input preparation.
matching: Each enumerated form is regex-escaped; internal phrase whitespace matches one or more Unicode whitespace characters; Unicode whole-word boundaries (?<!\w) and (?!\w). Hyphens and apostrophes are boundaries. No stemming, synonyms, inferred senses or additional forms.
normalization: Unicode casefold; no punctuation deletion or semantic cleanup

sensitivity.method: Remove every form in these eight families, including inflections and phrases containing their forms; retain the same complete bullet denominator. Content and passage-position lists are unchanged.

unit: One target bullet; each category and family contributes at most one hit per bullet, regardless of repeated or overlapping matches. Categories may overlap.
